title: Heavy Rain in the City
text:
Yesterday, heavy rain fell on the city all afternoon. Many streets were full of water, and some buses were late. The city council said the drains were blocked by leaves. Workers cleaned the drains during the night.

Today the sun is back, and the streets are dry again. The council will check the drains every week. People are asked to keep leaves away from the drains. Schools stayed open, so the children went to class as usual.

questions.text: What blocked the drains, according to the city council?
How often will the council check the drains?
Why were some buses late yesterday?
options: The streets were full of water

questions.text: What can the reader conclude about the children today?
options: They went to school as normal
They stayed at home all day

paragraph_translations: Ontem, uma chuva forte caiu sobre a cidade durante toda a tarde. Muitas ruas ficaram cheias de água, e alguns ônibus chegaram atrasados. A prefeitura disse que os bueiros estavam entupidos por folhas. Os trabalhadores limparam os bueiros durante a noite.

Hoje o sol voltou, e as ruas estão secas outra vez. A prefeitura vai verificar os bueiros toda semana. Pede-se às pessoas que mantenham as folhas longe dos bueiros. As escolas continuaram abertas, então as crianças foram às aulas como de costume.
